description_en: Determines whether an image is AI-generated and returns detection labels with confidence scores
description_zh: 判断图片是否由AI生成，并返回检测标签及置信度
name: DetectAigcImage

parameters.help_en: The URL of the image to detect. Only HTTP/HTTPS protocols are supported. You must provide at least one of `ImageUrl` and `ObjectKey`
parameters.help_zh: 待检测图片的 URL 地址，仅支持 HTTP/HTTPS 协议。`ImageUrl` 与 `ObjectKey` 二选一，至少提供一个
parameters.name: image_url

Body.description_en: The list of AIGC detection result labels
Body.description_zh: AIGC 检测结果标签列表

Confidence.description_en: The confidence score. Value range: 0 to 1. A higher value indicates a higher probability
Confidence.description_zh: 置信度，取值范围 0~1，值越大表示可能性越高

Label.description_en:
The detection label. Valid values:
`ai_generated`: AI-generated.
`non_ai_generated`: Not AI-generated
Label.description_zh:
检测标签。取值：
`ai_generated`（AI 生成）
`non_ai_generated`（非 AI 生成）

Code.description_en: The business error code. The value `OK` is returned if the request is successful
Code.description_zh: 业务错误码。请求成功时返回 `OK`

HttpStatusCode.description_en: The HTTP status code. The value `200` is returned if the request is successful
HttpStatusCode.description_zh: HTTP 状态码。请求成功时返回 `200`

Message.description_en: The additional information. The value `success` is returned if the request is successful
Message.description_zh: 附加信息。请求成功时返回 `success`

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful. Valid values:
true: Successful.
false: Failed
Success.description_zh: 表示是否调用成功。true：调用成功。                                 false：调用失败
